title: Three Piles
statement: Alice and Bob own piles of a and b stones and alternately (Alice first) move any number of stones, possibly zero, from a shared third pile of c stones into their own pile; the game ends after two consecutive zero moves. Alice maximizes and Bob minimizes the final |A−B|. With a, b, c up to 10^9, the optimal-play score must be found in O(1) by reasoning about the game.
